summary: Two-stage buffer initialization. First calls sub_5117C8(a1, a2) to initialize the target object/context a1 from source data a2, then invokes GuardedCallWithLongjmp(a1, v3) with a local 80-byte scratch buffer v3 (longjmp state) and returns its result. Result of the guarded call is propagated to the caller.

local_names.a1: target object or context pointer being initialized
local_names.a2: source data pointer used for initialization
local_names.v3: 80-byte local scratch buffer passed as longjmp state to the guarded call

operations.description: Call sub_5117C8(a1, a2) to perform the first initialization stage over the target object using the source data.
Call GuardedCallWithLongjmp(a1, v3) with the target object and the local 80-byte scratch buffer v3; the buffer serves as recoverable longjmp state.
Return the result of GuardedCallWithLongjmp to the caller.

unresolved: Type and layout of the target object a1 and the exact meaning of source data a2 are not documented in this function.
The 80-byte buffer v3 is most plausibly longjmp state for GuardedCallWithLongjmp, but its internal layout is not verifiable here.
Callers sub_517FD0, sub_518828 and sub_518FCF use this wrapper, but their per-caller buffer-ownership semantics are outside this function.
